inlines.v: VULNERARY, adjective Useful in healing wounds; adapted to the cure of external injuries; as vulnerary plants or potions. VULNERARY, adjective Any plant, drug or composition, useful in the cure of wounds. Certain unguents, balsams and the like, are used as vulneraries.
